snippet.title: 5 Weird New Japanese Stationery Products You Need to See! 🇯🇵
snippet.description:
Japanese stationery just keeps getting weirder! 🇯🇵✏️
Here are five new stationery releases from Japan, each with a unique approach to solving everyday problems.
KOKUYO's iconic Field Notebook gets a colorful collaboration with mt masking tape, while MAX brings back its discontinued HD-10V stapler that rotates to make booklets and zines.
KOKUYO also introduced mesh pouches that attach directly to your laptop, and Pilot's FriXion is collaborating with Dragon Ball on pens that switch between erasable and permanent ink.
Finally, Sun-Star's new Batten Marker features a unique cross-shaped tip that lets you create four different types of lines with a single marker!
Which one would you try?
